images.title: Pieces of one twentieth
images.purpose: Show that 5 pieces of 1/20 fit inside 1/4 of the strip and 2 pieces of 1/20 fit inside 1/10 of the strip.
images.composition: Two identical strips of 20 equal parts: the upper cut into 4 groups of 5 with the first group shaded, the lower cut into 10 groups of 2 with the first group shaded.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. At the top, centred at x 728 and y 80, the heading Each part of the strip is 1/20 in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (48 px). Two identical strips, one above the other, each a long rectangle of exactly 20 equal parts, every part 60 px wide and 100 px tall, so each strip is 1200 px wide (x 128 to 1328); thin dark #2B2B2B lines (2 px) between all parts and a 3 px outer outline. UPPER STRIP, y 160 to 260: 3 thick dark vertical lines (6 px) at x 428, 728 and 1028 cut the strip into 4 equal groups of 5 parts. The first group, the 5 parts at the left (x 128 to 428), is filled teal #0072B2; the other 15 parts are white. Under it, centred at x 728: 1/4 = 5/20 at y 330 (64 px bold) and 5 pieces of 1/20 at y 385 (36 px). LOWER STRIP, y 460 to 560: 9 thick dark vertical lines (6 px) at x 248, 368, 488, 608, 728, 848, 968, 1088 and 1208 cut the strip into 10 equal groups of 2 parts. The first group, the 2 parts at the left (x 128 to 248), is filled amber #E69F00; the other 18 parts are white. Under it, centred at x 728: 1/10 = 2/20 at y 630 (64 px bold) and 2 pieces of 1/20 at y 685 (36 px). No other text, no numbers inside the parts. Nothing else in the frame.
labels: Each part of the strip is 1/20
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a strip with a number of parts other than 20, or a shaded group of any size other than 5 parts in the upper strip and 2 parts in the lower strip
images.takeaway: The number of small pieces that fit in a bigger piece is the top number of its new name: 5/20 = 1/4 and 2/20 = 1/10.
images.description: Two strips of 20 equal parts: 5 shaded parts named 1/4 = 5/20 on the upper strip, and 2 shaded parts named 1/10 = 2/20 on the lower strip.
images.context: Concept image for How Many Small Pieces Fit in a Bigger One. It follows the idea of the figure in your maths book (a strip of small equal parts with a bigger piece covered by them) and uses the numbers of this concept's own example: a strip of 20 parts, 1/4 and 1/10.
images.teaching_notes: Count the small parts inside the shaded group aloud. The slip to watch: counting the groups (4 or 10) instead of the small parts that fit inside one group.

image_decisions.why: The strip of 20 parts with its shaded group of 5 and group of 2 make counting small pieces inside a bigger piece visible.
